issue_context.title: Replace userDefines in html files for dev
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

The following config works in build but not in debug mode:
```js
export default {
  define: {
    __ANALYTICS_URL__ : `'<script async src="https://www.google-analytics.com/analytics.js" />'`
  }
}
```

it is used in index.html like so:
```html
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    __ANALYTICS_URL__
    <title>My Webapp</title>
  </head>
...
```

When used in build mode the `__ANALYTICS_URL__` gets replaced in the html file as expected. In dev mode, since there it is only injected via global var, the index.html contains the string "__ANALYTICS_URL__" inside the HEAD tag which the browser can't handle.

### Reproduction

https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-e1cdpf?file=index.html

comments: We talked about this feature a few months ago, it was brought up a few times before. `define` is only intended to work on js sources. If you want to do a replacement in the HTML code, a plugin with [`transformIndexHTML`](https://vitejs.dev/guide/api-plugin.html#transformindexhtml) should be used.
Is this a bug then? When building the application the string IS replaced inside the HTML files. I would expect that to not work if its not intended.
If that is the case, reopening, this should be replaced during build AFAICS

> We talked about this feature a few months ago, it was brought up a few times before. `define` is only intended to work on js sources.

thanks @patak-dev This is a good decision.🎉
Now think about it. in dev mode inject the variable had better performance than replace. Modifying the string template is easy to make a unexpected errors.
